Protocol.Policy: No prewarm/forced GC. First execution retained. Three cold processes per fixture/side; alternate pair order. Four repeated complete constructions and three fresh distant-source revisions. Same fixed six-fixture order. Replication 2 reverses initial order. Independent correctness follows every timed sample.

Scope: All original per-sample scalar/stage/allocation/GC/correctness observations. Original bounded dispatcher operation arrays remain in the linked Actions artefact; each raw JSON is hashed here. No samples removed.
